cd /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-muahmed-Desktop-Projects-RL-for-Real-World-Environments/54b8300a-e533-4d3f-9f31-c0f8369fa981/scratchpad/lhrun/runs/solvers/samples/1d816017cb4e3a22/a2/work/ws && python3 -c "
import parse

# Test various timezone formats
test_cases = [
    ('a {:tt} b', 'a 10:21:36 PM -5:30 b'),
    ('a {:tt} b', 'a 10:21:36 PM -530 b'),
    ('a {:tt} b', 'a 10:21:36 PM -05:30 b'),
    ('a {:tt} b', 'a 10:21:36 PM -0530 b'),
    ('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b'),
    ('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+01:00 b'),
]

t530 = parse.FixedTzOffset(-5 * 60 - 30, '-5:30')
tz60 = parse.FixedTzOffset(60, '+01:00')

for fmt, s in test_cases:
    result = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    if result:
        print(f'Input: {s!r}')
        print(f'  Result tzinfo: {result[0].tzinfo}')
        if '-5' in s or '+01' in s:
            expected = t530 if '-5' in s else tz60
            print(f'  Expected: {expected}')
            print(f'  Match: {result[0].tzinfo == expected}')
        print()
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
